name: Stamina tonic
description: Green, bitter and sold as a cure for tiredness, which it is, until it is not.
notes: A minor stamina potion (mw-ju8.4), buy and use only: no brewing yet. Restores 50 stamina; the minor tier is the existing mana draught at 30. Base value 20 sits in the economy minor potion band. Magnitudes are a placeholder scale for the balance tool.
